prerequisites: Course succeeds to compulsory courses of previous semester

learning_outcomes.text: explains the basic principles of safety in activities involving electrical equipment
applies the requirements of legal and technical regulations related to electrical safety
assesses risks associated with the operation of electrical equipment and proposes appropriate preventive measures
applies the principles of safe working practices when working with electrical equipment in accordance with applicable regulations
understand legal and technical requirements for safety when working with electrical equipment
identify and assess risks associated with the operation of electrical equipment
apply appropriate principles of protection against electric shock
carrying out activities involving electrical equipment safely and for the responsible application of applicable legal and technical requirements

syllabus_topics: Safety in electrotechnics. Terms, sense, regulations and standards. Skills in electrotechnics according to Czech law - Vyhl.50/1978, Zák. 262/2006-labour code, codes 22/1997, NV 17/2003 Sb., NV 176/2008 Sb., validity area.
Identificatin by colours – conductor, tell-tales, indicators, actuators, control devices according to Europian standards - EN 60445 ed.3, EN 60446 ed.2, ČSN 33 0165, EN 60073 ed.2, warning boards.

Basic principles of protection against electric shoc - philosophy of protection against electric shock(HD 60364 – 4 – 41), ambiente influence, touch voltage (HD 60364 – 1, 5-51, HD 60364 – 4 – 41 ed.2)
Supply systems (HD 60364 – 1), the way of protection against electric shock (HD60364 – 4 – 41), external influences and internationa protection code (HD 60364 – 5-51, EN 60529 )
Lines/cables – design and protection of line, permissive current load HD 60364 – 5 – 52, HD 60364 – 5 – 523, components for protection in low voltage systems.

Live working, operation of electrical installation, preparation of work location - communication, important parts from EN 50110-1, definition of live working zone, vicinity zone, preparation of work zone for dead working,
The first aid by electric shock, fire extinguishing of electrical devices and installation
teaching_methods: Teaching by an expert (lecture or tutorial)
